engine_condition: quadrant containing an assigned position is unlocked; tile becomes owned empty soil
preventive_action: BUY_LAND is a market decision before the tile is usable
minimum_worker_actions: 0 tile actions; 1 market order if land is locked
revenue_opportunity: creates an opportunity but no output by itself

engine_condition: PLANT on tile is None with valid crop and positive seed inventory; atomic seed validation must pass
source_variables: tile; crop; private.seeds; same-turn PLANT demand
economic_cost: one seed at crop seed cost
revenue_opportunity: opens crop yield opportunity and daily care load

engine_condition: WATER on PLANT with watered_today=false sets watered_today=true; non-ongoing yield may increase inside its age window
source_variables: kind; watered_today; crop; planted_day; current_day; fertilized_until_day; yield_units
revenue_opportunity: preserves plant and can increase non-ongoing yield

engine_condition: non-ongoing: current_day-planted_day reaches first_yield_day while yield_units>0; derived state, no mutation required
preventive_action: schedule valid HARVEST no earlier than readiness

engine_condition: ongoing crop survives end-of-day and its planted-day schedule reaches first_yield_day plus an interval; yield_units increments
source_variables: crop; planted_day; next_day; interval; production_count; yield_units; watered_today; fertilized_until_day
preventive_action: maintain WATER and schedule valid HARVEST
minimum_worker_actions: 0 actions for production transition; WATER is 1 action when due
revenue_opportunity: creates one or two collectible units up to max_yield

engine_condition: valid HARVEST on non-ongoing PLANT: yield_units>0 and age>=first_yield_day; inventory receives units and tile becomes None
source_variables: kind; crop; yield_units; planted_day; current_day; ongoing
revenue_opportunity: collects yield; replant is required to reopen production

engine_condition: valid HARVEST on ongoing PLANT before final scheduled production; yield_units becomes 0 and tile remains PLANT
source_variables: kind; crop; yield_units; planted_day; current_day; interval; production_count; max_lifespan_step
revenue_opportunity: collects yield while preserving later scheduled output

engine_condition: valid HARVEST after the final ongoing production; yield_units becomes 0, max_lifespan_step is set, and no future production is scheduled
source_variables: kind; crop; yield_units; planted_day; current_day; max_yield; interval; max_lifespan_step
preventive_action: HARVEST before decay, then planned DIG and PLANT
minimum_worker_actions: 1 HARVEST plus 1 DIG; replant adds 1 PLANT
revenue_opportunity: collects final yield and avoids leaving exhausted soil blocked

engine_condition: at end-of-day an unwatered PLANT increments consecutive_unwatered but remains below 2; watered PLANT resets the counter to 0; watered_today resets false
minimum_worker_actions: 1 worker action when service is due
revenue_opportunity: preserves the crop and its future yield opportunity

engine_condition: at end-of-day an unwatered PLANT reaches consecutive_unwatered>=2; planting day starts at 1 and therefore requires same-day WATER
preventive_action: WATER before refresh; avoid unserviceable late-day PLANT
minimum_worker_actions: 1 preventive WATER; after loss 1 DIG plus 1 PLANT
revenue_opportunity: destroys remaining crop opportunity and blocks the tile

engine_condition: on each eligible decay tick at or after max_lifespan_step, yield_units decrements but stays above 0
preventive_action: valid HARVEST before or on the action phase preceding decay
revenue_opportunity: each missed decay tick destroys one collectible unit

engine_condition: an eligible lifespan decay tick decrements yield_units to <=0
preventive_action: valid HARVEST before decay; ongoing final-cycle tile also needs planned clearance
minimum_worker_actions: 1 HARVEST for non-ongoing; ongoing clean turnover needs HARVEST plus DIG
revenue_opportunity: destroys uncollected yield and blocks the tile

engine_condition: first eligible lifespan decay tick decrements ongoing post-harvest yield_units=0 below zero
source_variables: max_lifespan_step; canonical day/hour step; yield_units; ongoing
preventive_action: planned DIG after final HARVEST and before decay
revenue_opportunity: no remaining crop yield is lost, but productive surface is blocked

engine_condition: during end-of-day refresh, rng.random()<weedSpawnChance on an empty unlocked tile
source_variables: tile is None; day/hour; weedSpawnChance; hidden episode seed/random draw
preventive_action: remove empty exposure by timely PLANT or other occupancy; no tile-specific draw is predictable
minimum_worker_actions: 1 DIG after spawn; replant adds 1 PLANT
revenue_opportunity: blocks a replant opportunity; no live crop is replaced

engine_condition: DIG on WEED sets the tile to None
revenue_opportunity: restores soil access but creates no output until PLANT

engine_condition: DIG on an exhausted ongoing PLANT sets the tile to None before WEED conversion
revenue_opportunity: preserves tile availability; PLANT is still required
